data.title: Privacy Policy
data.summary: How Lakefront Digital collects, uses, and protects personal information when you use our website and services.
data.keywords: privacy, personal information, cookies, Google Analytics, data retention, security, your rights

children.text: and provides web design, hosting, and consulting services. This policy explains what personal information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have.
your name, email address, website, project details, and anything else you include when you send an enquiry or book a consultation.
billing contacts, and the account access and content you share so we can deliver your project.
IP address, browser and device type, pages requested, and referring pages, recorded automatically by our hosting, security, and analytics providers.
Reply to enquiries and prepare proposals
Deliver, support, and bill for the services you engage us for
Keep our site, and the sites we host, secure
Meet legal, tax, and accounting obligations
We don't sell or rent personal information.

We use Cloudflare Web Analytics to understand how visitors find and use our site. It doesn't use cookies or local storage and doesn't follow you across other sites. It counts page views and records basic details such as the page, the site that referred you, and your browser, device type, and country. Our security provider, Cloudflare, may set cookies needed to protect the site. We don't use advertising cookies.

With service providers that help us run our business, such as Cloudflare (hosting, security, analytics, and email delivery) and our email provider. They may use it only to provide their services to us.
When the law requires it, or to protect our rights and the safety of others.
As part of a merger, acquisition, or sale of our business.

When we build, host, or maintain a website for a client, we handle the personal information on that site, such as orders and form submissions, only on the client's instructions and to provide our services. The client's privacy policy governs that information, so please contact them with questions about it.

We keep enquiries that don't become projects for up to two years, and client records for as long as we work together and afterwards as tax and accounting rules require. When we no longer need information, we delete or anonymize it.
We protect information with encryption in transit, access controls, and reputable providers. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, so we can't guarantee absolute security.
You can ask us to access, correct, or delete the personal information we hold about you, or to stop contacting you. Email
and we'll respond within 30 days. Depending on where you live, you may have additional rights under local law.
Our site and services are for people 18 and older. We don't knowingly collect personal information from children.
We're based in Illinois, in the United States. Our providers may process information in the United States and other countries.
We may update this policy. Changes take effect when posted, and we'll update the effective date at the top of this page.
